packages.title: The repeat sheet shows that its details go on under Listo
brief: Round 3 of P281's UX-2407, after P301 (round 2, verified: UX-2621's divider and UX-2622's pinned Listo, verify-b2-r2-B.md). Keep everything P301 built in `_RepeatSheetState.build` (App/lib/widgets/repeat_rule_control.dart:114-201): `SafeArea > Column(min, stretch) > [Flexible(SingleChildScrollView(padding fromLTRB 24,24,24,0)), Padding(fromLTRB 24,16,24,24, FilledButton Listo)]`, the `const Divider(height: 24)` before `RepeatRuleControl`, the five `repeat-$value` rows with their ✓, and `Navigator.pop(context, _task)`. No copy, no ARB change.

What the last attempt did and why it failed (UX-2632, S2, regression R2B-1): pinning Listo removed the only cue that the sheet scrolls. In render `form/repeat-sheet.open.ca.light.2x` the scroll area ends exactly under the first row of weekday chips («dl. dt. dc. dj.»); «dv. ds. dg.», «Utilitza el dia de la setmana…» and the end-date row are out of sight, with no scrollbar and no row cut in half, so a newcomer taps «Fet» without finding them. In `es.light.2x` only a 23 dp sliver of the chips peeks out.

Fix, both parts, at the scrolling part (:125-126): (1) Make `_RepeatSheetState` own a `final _scroll = ScrollController();`, disposed in `dispose()`. Pass it to the `SingleChildScrollView` (`controller: _scroll`) and wrap that `SingleChildScrollView`, inside the `Flexible`, in `Scrollbar(controller: _scroll, thumbVisibility: true, child: …)`. Flutter's Scrollbar paints nothing when there is nothing to scroll, so at 1× (everything fits) no thumb shows. (2) Between the `Flexible` and Listo's `Padding`, add a 1 dp edge shown only while the content overflows, as the reminder sheet's fixed header has (UX-2035, App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart:797-800): `Divider(height: 1, key: const ValueKey('repeat-sheet-foot-edge'), color: _overflows ? null : Colors.transparent)`. Keep its height constant (transparent rather than removed) so the sheet doesn't jump by 1 dp. Set a `bool _overflows = false;` from a `NotificationListener<ScrollMetricsNotification>` around the Scrollbar: `_overflows = n.metrics.maxScrollExtent > 0`, calling setState only when the value changes, and return false so the Scrollbar still gets the notification. It tracks overflow, not position: the edge stays while the content can scroll, and doesn't flicker as it scrolls.

Tests: run App/test/recurrence_controls_test.dart, task_editor_form_test.dart, review_tasks_test.dart, task_creation_test.dart and reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart. A Scrollbar adds no Scrollable, so `find.byType(Scrollable).last` in recurrence_controls_test.dart:55-69 still finds the sheet's list; none should need changing; say if one does. Previews: re-render form/ (`--plain-name "form/"`). Keep the `repeat-sheet` · `open` description (App/test/ux_previews/form_previews.dart:291-295) true: add that at 2× a scrollbar thumb and a line above Listo show that the details go on.

Not yours: `RepeatRuleControl` and the interval dialog (:1-98), the weekday chips' size (AUDIT's pre-existing 2× flag), the five rows' 0 dp gaps (pre-existing from P281), the form (task_editor.dart), reminder_plan_sheet.dart.
acceptance: Repeat sheet with «Cada semana» ticked, CA and ES at 2× on 360×800: the sheet's Scrollbar has thumbVisibility on and its scroll position has maxScrollExtent > 0, so a thumb is painted beside the details; render `form/repeat-sheet.open.ca.light.2x` shows the thumb.
Same sheet, CA and ES at 2× on 360×800: the edge `repeat-sheet-foot-edge` sits directly above «Fet»/«Listo» and is drawn (not transparent).

Repeat sheet, ES 1× on 360×800, with «Cada semana» ticked and with «No se repite» ticked: nothing scrolls (maxScrollExtent 0), no thumb is painted, and `repeat-sheet-foot-edge` is transparent; the sheet still hugs its content.
At ES 2× with «Cada semana», scrolling the sheet to its end brings «Sin fecha de fin» into view while «Listo» stays where it was, whole on screen.

P301's checks still hold: «Listo» whole on screen at ES and CA 2×; the divider between «Cada año» and the interval row at ES 1×; «Cada mes» then Listo returns recurrence 'monthly'; the end-date row opens the date picker.

packages.title: A task's page is inert while Completar closes it, and never stays frozen
brief: Round 3 of P280's UX-2404, after P302 (round 2, verified: UX-2623's 300 ms hold with «Añadir tarea»'s leaving guard, and UX-2624's no-break space, verify-b2-r2-B.md). Keep all of it: `_toggle` (App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:59-73) sets `_leaving` and `_closing`, ticks at once through `TaskInteractions.toggle`, waits 300 ms, then pops; the bottom bar's Completar and «Cambiar fecha» are `onPressed: null` while `_closing` (:551-566); «Reabrir» takes the early return with no hold; `_pinned`; task_actions.dart's guard. No copy, no ARB change.

What the last attempt did and why it failed (UX-2633, S2, regression R2B-2): only the two bottom buttons go dead during the hold. ✏ and the delete button in the app bar (:233-246), the «Planificado para» row (the reschedule sheet), the other detail rows (the form), the reminder chip and the steps stay live. If one opens a route or a sheet within the 300 ms, the route isn't current when the wait ends, so `_toggle` returns without popping and never clears `_closing` or `_leaving`. Coming back, the page shows the task as open, with Completar and «Cambiar fecha» greyed out for good, though it is ticked.

Fix, two parts. (1) The whole page is inert while it closes: in the data branch, wrap the `Scaffold` returned at :228 in `AbsorbPointer(absorbing: _closing, child: Scaffold(…))`. That covers the app bar's actions, the body and the bottom bar in one place; a tap on the app bar's Back in those 300 ms is absorbed too, which is fine, because the page closes by itself at 300 ms (system Back still works, as now). Keep the two buttons' `onPressed: null` while `_closing`, so TalkBack still reads them as disabled. Don't wrap the loading, error or 'task unavailable' Scaffolds. (2) `_toggle` never leaves the page frozen: after the wait, read `final route = ModalRoute.of(context);` once mounted, then: if `route?.isCurrent ?? false`, pop as now; else if `route?.isActive ?? false` (something opened over the page: a route, a sheet or a dialog, which TalkBack can still reach, since AbsorbPointer stops pointers only), `setState(() { _closing = false; _leaving = null; })`, so on return the page shows the real, ticked task with «Reabrir» enabled, and doesn't pop by itself; otherwise (Back already popped it) return, as now, with no setState, so a leaving page doesn't flash «Reabrir». Update the doc comments on `_closing` and `_toggle` to match.

Tests: run App/test/task_detail_test.dart (the P280 and P302 groups), home_screen_test.dart, day_timeline_test.dart and calendar_feedback_test.dart. P302's 'nothing opens' tests at 50, 200 and 400 ms should pass unchanged; a test that taps another control of the page during the hold and expects it to open is rightly broken: update it and say so. Previews: none change (the hold isn't rendered); don't re-render.

Not yours: task_actions.dart (P302's guard stays as is), TaskInteractions and its message copy, calendar_screen.dart, the screens without TaskActions that the verify note lists as a residual (Activity, Notas, Tasks with files): not planned.
acceptance: ES 1× on 360×800, Calendar row → task page → Completar, then a tap on ✏ at 100 ms and 400 ms pumped: no task form opens, the page closes once, and Calendar shows the row ticked with one «Tarea completada · Deshacer».
Same, with the tap at 100 ms on the «Planificado para» row, then on the reminder chip, then on a step of a task with steps: no sheet and no route opens, and no step changes.

Completar, then a route pushed over the task page within 100 ms (by a semantics tap on ✏ or by the test's navigator), then 400 ms pumped and Back: the task page is still there, shows «Reabrir» enabled and «Cambiar fecha» enabled, no «Completar», and doesn't pop by itself.
Completar, then system Back at 100 ms: the page closes once, Calendar is not popped, and after 400 ms nothing else changes.

P302's checks still hold: taps on Completar's spot at 50, 200 and 400 ms open nothing and complete nothing more; during the hold the main button reads «Completar» with a check icon and is disabled for TalkBack; «Reabrir» on a completed task keeps the page at once.
deviceChecks: Emulator, then phone, with TalkBack: on a task's page, Completar then a quick double-tap on ✏: either the page closes and nothing opens, or after Back from the form the page shows «Reabrir».
